Calculate Pressure and Flow Profile Along a Lateral Line (Backstep Procedure)

Source: R/calc_backstep.R
calc_backstep.Rd

Calculates the pressure head and flow rate profile along an irrigation lateral line, starting from the distal end (last emitter) and stepping backwards to the inlet using the Darcy-Weisbach equation via hf::calc_head_loss_darcy().

Usage

calc_backstep(
  end_pressure,
  diameter,
  spacing,
  n_emitters,
  slope = 0,
  emitter_coef,
  emitter_exp,
  ...
)

Arguments

end_pressure

Numeric. Pressure head at the end of the lateral line (last emitter) in meters of water column (mca).

diameter

Numeric. Internal pipe diameter in meters (m).

spacing

Numeric vector or single value. Emitter spacing in meters (m).

n_emitters

Integer. Total number of emitters on the lateral line (must be >= 2).

slope

Numeric. Elevation change (slope) per meter of pipe (m/m). Positive values indicate uphill slope, negative values indicate downhill slope. Defaults to 0.

emitter_coef

Numeric. Emitter discharge coefficient in SI units (\(\text{m}^3\,\text{s}^{-1}\,\text{mca}^{-x}\)).

emitter_exp

Numeric. Emitter discharge exponent (between 0 and 1).

...

Additional arguments passed to hf::calc_head_loss_darcy() (such as roughness, friction_factor, or viscosity). Either roughness or friction_factor must be supplied.

Value

A tibble::tibble() containing the hydraulic profile of the lateral line:

  • emitter: Integer emitter index (1 is the first emitter near the inlet, n is the last).

  • pressure_head: Pressure head at each emitter (mca).

  • emitter_flow: Flow rate discharged by each emitter (\(\text{m}^3\,\text{s}^{-1}\)).

  • section_flow: Flow rate in the pipe section immediately upstream of the emitter (\(\text{m}^3\,\text{s}^{-1}\)).

  • head_loss: Friction head loss in the pipe section upstream of the emitter (m).

Examples

# Lateral line with 5 emitters, 1 m spacing, and smooth PE roughness (1.5e-6 m)
calc_backstep(
  end_pressure = 10,
  diameter = 0.012,
  spacing = 1,
  n_emitters = 5,
  slope = 0,
  emitter_coef = 8.84e-7,
  emitter_exp = 0.50,
  roughness = 1.5e-6
)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 5
#>   emitter pressure_head emitter_flow section_flow head_loss
#>     <int>         <dbl>        <dbl>        <dbl>     <dbl>
#> 1       1          10.0   0.00000280   0.0000140   0.00225 
#> 2       2          10.0   0.00000280   0.0000112   0.00169 
#> 3       3          10.0   0.00000280   0.00000839  0.00112 
#> 4       4          10.0   0.00000280   0.00000559  0.000562
#> 5       5          10     0.00000280   0.00000280  0       

# Drip lateral line with 12 emitters and 0.3 m spacing
calc_backstep(
  end_pressure = 10,
  diameter = 0.012,
  spacing = 0.3,
  n_emitters = 12,
  slope = 0,
  emitter_coef = 3.18 / 3.6e6,
  emitter_exp = 0.50,
  roughness = 1.5e-6
)
#> # A tibble: 12 × 5
#>    emitter pressure_head emitter_flow section_flow head_loss
#>      <int>         <dbl>        <dbl>        <dbl>     <dbl>
#>  1       1          10.0   0.00000280   0.0000335   0.00401 
#>  2       2          10.0   0.00000280   0.0000307   0.00341 
#>  3       3          10.0   0.00000279   0.0000279   0.00285 
#>  4       4          10.0   0.00000279   0.0000251   0.00234 
#>  5       5          10.0   0.00000279   0.0000223   0.00187 
#>  6       6          10.0   0.00000279   0.0000196   0.00101 
#>  7       7          10.0   0.00000279   0.0000168   0.000843
#>  8       8          10.0   0.00000279   0.0000140   0.000674
#>  9       9          10.0   0.00000279   0.0000112   0.000506
#> 10      10          10.0   0.00000279   0.00000838  0.000337
#> 11      11          10.0   0.00000279   0.00000559  0.000169
#> 12      12          10     0.00000279   0.00000279  0
